title: Configurational Pathways to Firm Innovation Across Europe
description: Reproducible research software and documentation for a firm-level fsQCA study of innovation across European macroregions. The release includes the typed Python pipeline, study specification, diagnostics, robustness checks, R validation workflow, manuscript scaffold, review records, and release report. It does not include raw or case-level World Bank Enterprise Survey microdata or empirical WBES findings.

creators.name: Ribeiro, Diogo
creators.affiliation: ESMAD - School of Media Arts and Design, Polytechnic of Porto

notes: Synthetic data and synthetic outputs are included only to validate the software pipeline. Licensed WBES microdata must be obtained separately under the applicable access terms and must not be committed to this repository.
